from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's current liabilities total from its financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    current_liabilities_total: float | None = Field(description="The 'total current liabilities' amount in numeric form")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency/amount unit (e.g., '元', 'CNY')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the liabilities figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
